basis: Aggregate design-variety study of Shirts.zip plus the permanent FS-HD art grammar. No benchmark coordinates, pixels, palettes, silhouettes, or outfits are encoded.

topologyRules.front_only: A focal motif or closure terminates at the front side seam.
topologyRules.front_back: The system appears in front and back but simplifies on the back.
topologyRules.front_back_pair: A front focal motif receives a smaller related back mark.
topologyRules.wrap: A band continues through both sides and back without phase jumps.
topologyRules.shoulder_wrap: The front shoulder gesture crosses the side cap into the upper back.
topologyRules.construction_bound: Decoration follows an existing collar, lapel, yoke, placket, cuff, or hem region.
topologyRules.asymmetric_front: The focal mark is intentionally front-only and offset; side visibility is limited to the matching side.

compositionRules: Exactly one surface system is dominant.
Supporting systems must reinforce the focal gesture rather than create a second focal point.
Large color regions resolve before trims, motifs, patterns, and micro details.
Motifs use connected clusters and a maximum of three role colors.
Back views reduce focal detail but retain a family cue when topology calls for it.
Side views carry wrapping systems or seam terminations; they do not copy the front motif.
Unused cells are preferable to filler texture.
